issue.title: DateValidator|date throws yii\base\ErrorException instead form error

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
When I use the 'date' validation rule for attributes, it throws an exception by incorrect input.

Example Field: birthday
Example Rule: ['birthday', 'date', 'format' => 'Y-m-d']
Example Form input: 'blablub'
Throws:  PHP Warning – yii\base\ErrorException // IntlDateFormatter::parse(): Date parsing failed

I'm doing something wrong?

body:
Output is:

```
PHP: 5.5.12 ICU: 51.2 
Warning: IntlDateFormatter::parse(): Date parsing failed in C:\wamp\www\CVCVMProperty\web\date-test.php on line 11
bool(false) 
Warning: IntlDateFormatter::parse(): Date parsing failed in C:\wamp\www\CVCVMProperty\web\date-test.php on line 16
bool(false)
```

I had a look at #5249 and changed my config file to the following:

```
'components' => [ 
...
   'formatter' => [
            'class' => 'yii\i18n\Formatter',            
            'dateFormat' => 'php:Y-m-d', // commenting this line out results in the parse error
            'datetimeFormat'=>'php:h:mm a d MMM y',
            'nullDisplay' => '-'
        ],
...]
```

With this configuration, the issue stops and the date validator in my model works when submitting a form.

> With this configuration, the issue stops and the date validator in my model works when submitting a form.

Yes, the problem seems to exist in `IntlDateFormatter` on windows only...
Reported the issue to PHP: https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=68528
